summary.zh: OpenAI 推出的通用大型语言模型家族，覆盖对话、代码、推理与多模态能力，是当前商业化最成熟的闭源前沿模型之一。
summary.en: OpenAI's general-purpose LLM family covering chat, code, reasoning and multimodal capabilities; among the most commercially mature closed frontier models today.

summary.zh: GPT 系列的原生多模态版本，将文本、图像与语音整合进单一模型，重点改善实时交互速度与成本。
summary.en: A native multimodal GPT release unifying text, image, and audio, with an emphasis on latency and cost.

summary.zh: 面向自然对话、知识广度与创意写作的过渡版本，推理方式更自然，但 API 成本明显高于 GPT-4o。
summary.en: A transitional release focused on natural conversation, broad knowledge, and writing quality, at a substantially higher API price than GPT-4o.

summary.zh: GPT 系列当前演示旗舰版本，统一快速响应与深度推理，强化代码、长上下文、多模态与 Agent 工具调用。
summary.en: The current demo flagship GPT release, unifying fast responses and deep reasoning with stronger code, long context, multimodality, and agentic tool use.

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出的以安全对齐与长文本理解见长的大型语言模型家族，Claude 4.5 强化了代码与 Agent 场景。
summary.en: Anthropic's LLM family known for safety alignment and long-context understanding; Claude 4.5 focuses on code and agentic use cases.

summary.zh: Claude 系列的重要效率版本，强化代码、视觉理解与 Artifacts 交互，在性能和价格之间取得平衡。
summary.en: A major efficiency release adding stronger code, vision, and Artifacts while balancing capability and price.

summary.zh: 面向长时间 Agent 任务与复杂代码工程的版本，增加扩展思考和更稳定的多步骤工具调用。
summary.en: A release for long-running agent tasks and complex software engineering, adding extended thinking and steadier multi-step tool use.

specs.toolUse: 并行工具调用 · Computer use

summary.zh: Claude 系列当前演示旗舰版本，进一步提升代码、长文档和 Agent 稳定性，并降低安全策略的误拒率。
summary.en: The current demo flagship Claude release with stronger code, long-document work, and agent reliability, plus fewer false safety refusals.

specs.toolUse: 并行工具调用 · MCP · Computer use

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 的多模态旗舰模型家族，原生支持文本、图像、音频与视频输入。
summary.en: Google DeepMind's multimodal flagship family with native text, image, audio and video inputs.

summary.zh: Gemini 系列率先把超长上下文带入稳定产品形态的版本，适合长文档、代码库和长视频分析。
summary.en: The Gemini release that brought ultra-long context into a stable product for documents, codebases and long video.

summary.en: Adds thinking, coding and complex multimodal reasoning on top of long context; the current demo Gemini flagship.

summary.zh: 国产开源前沿模型代表，DeepSeek R2 主打推理与代码，训练与推理成本大幅低于同代闭源模型。
summary.en: Leading Chinese open-source frontier models; DeepSeek R2 focuses on reasoning and code with markedly lower training & inference cost.

summary.zh: DeepSeek 的通用 MoE 基座版本，重点优化训练效率、中文、代码与开放权重部署。
summary.en: DeepSeek's general MoE foundation release focused on training efficiency, Chinese, code and open-weight deployment.

summary.en: Alibaba's open-weight model family covering chat, code, vision and audio with a complete open ecosystem.

summary.zh: 月之暗面 Kimi 以超长上下文与深度阅读见长，主打个人研究与文档理解。
summary.en: Moonshot's Kimi is known for ultra-long context and deep-reading workflows for personal research.

summary.zh: 字节跳动的豆包模型家族，服务于抖音、剪映等 C 端产品，主打低成本与高并发。
summary.en: ByteDance's Doubao family powering consumer products like Douyin & CapCut, focused on cost and throughput.

summary.zh: 百度文心系列模型，2026 年升级为 ERNIE 5，强化了搜索增强与行业解决方案能力。
summary.en: Baidu's ERNIE family, upgraded to ERNIE 5 in 2026 with search-augmented and industry solutions.

summary.zh: 总部位于旧金山的 AI 研究与产品公司，GPT 系列与 ChatGPT 的开发者。
summary.en: SF-based AI research and product company; developer of the GPT family and ChatGPT.

summary.zh: 以安全对齐为核心方向的 AI 公司，Claude 系列的开发者。
summary.en: Safety-focused AI company; developer of Claude.

summary.zh: 面向 LLM 应用编排的开源框架，覆盖链、工具、Agent 与检索增强。
summary.en: Open-source framework for LLM app orchestration: chains, tools, agents and RAG.

summary.zh: 针对真实 GitHub Issue 的代码修复评测，衡量模型端到端解决工程问题的能力。
summary.en: Real-world GitHub issue coding benchmark measuring end-to-end engineering task solving.

summary.zh: 覆盖 57 个学科的多任务语言理解评测的强化版，更抗污染。
summary.en: Harder, contamination-resistant version of the 57-subject multitask language benchmark.

summary.zh: 提出 Transformer 架构的开山论文，奠定了现代大模型的基础。
summary.en: Seminal paper introducing the Transformer architecture behind modern LLMs.

summary.zh: 由 Anthropic 提出的模型上下文协议，定义模型与外部工具、数据源交互的开放接口。
summary.en: Anthropic-proposed open protocol for how models talk to external tools & data sources.

summary.zh: 深度集成大模型的代码编辑器，是 Agent 编码的代表产品之一。
summary.en: AI-native code editor and one of the flagship agentic coding products.

title.zh: 社区讨论：GPT-5 上下文窗口传闻

text.zh: GPT-5 在 SWE-bench Verified 上取得 62.4% 的通过率。
text.en: GPT-5 achieves 62.4% pass rate on SWE-bench Verified.

technical.zh: 在 SWE-bench Verified 500 题子集上，GPT-5 (2026-07-12 发布版) 单次尝试的解决率为 62.4%。
technical.en: On the 500-task SWE-bench Verified subset, GPT-5 (2026-07-12 release) solves 62.4% in a single attempt.

text.zh: GPT-5 支持 1,000,000 token 的上下文窗口。
Claude 4.5 在 Anthropic 官方安全评估中拒绝率下降 18%，同时保持有害请求识别率。
text.en: Claude 4.5 reduces false refusals by 18% while retaining harmful-request detection per Anthropic's evals.

text.zh: DeepSeek R2 的推理成本约为同代闭源模型的 1/10。
text.en: DeepSeek R2 inference cost is roughly 1/10 of comparable closed models.

text.zh: Gemini 2.5 Pro 原生支持 2 小时长视频输入。
text.en: Gemini 2.5 Pro natively supports up to 2-hour video inputs.

summary.zh: 1.17 亿参数，验证“通用预训练 + 任务微调”路线；以文本理解为主，尚无公开 API 定价。
summary.en: 117M parameters validated general pre-training plus task fine-tuning; text-only and no public API pricing.

summary.zh: 扩展到 1750 亿参数，重点变化是无需微调的 few-shot 提示能力，并开始形成按 token 计费的 API 产品形态。
summary.en: Scaled to 175B parameters, introduced strong few-shot prompting and established token-priced API access.

summary.zh: 将指令微调与对话界面结合，5 天内突破百万用户；模型能力从 API 组件变成普通用户可直接使用的产品。
summary.en: Combined instruction tuning with a chat UI, reaching 1M users in five days and turning model APIs into a consumer product.

summary.zh: 新增图像输入并显著提高复杂推理；首发提供 8K / 32K 上下文，演示归一化 API 价格约为输入 $30、输出 $60 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Added image input and stronger reasoning, with 8K/32K context; normalized launch pricing was about $30 input and $60 output per 1M tokens.

title.zh: GPT-4o：原生全模态与成本下降
title.en: GPT-4o: native omni and lower cost

summary.zh: 文本、图像与音频走向原生统一处理，延迟明显降低；128K 上下文，演示价格为输入 $2.5、输出 $10 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Unified text, image and audio processing with lower latency; 128K context and demo pricing of $2.5 input / $10 output per 1M tokens.

summary.zh: 重点改善知识覆盖、写作自然度与意图理解，而非单纯追求推理速度；128K 上下文，演示价格为输入 $75、输出 $150 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Focused on knowledge, natural writing and intent understanding rather than raw reasoning speed; 128K context and demo pricing of $75/$150.

summary.zh: 统一推理、多模态与 Agent 工具调用；上下文扩至 256K、支持 8 个并行工具，演示价格为输入 $0.5、输出 $1.5 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Unified reasoning, multimodality and agentic tool use; 256K context, eight parallel tools and demo pricing of $0.5/$1.5.

summary.zh: 多个开发者社区讨论 GPT-5 可能支持 1M token 上下文，官方未确认。
summary.en: Developers speculate 1M context for GPT-5; not officially confirmed.

summary.zh: Anthropic 首个对外模型产品，以长文本、可靠对话和 Constitutional AI 路线为主要差异点。
summary.en: Anthropic's first public model, differentiated by long-form dialogue and Constitutional AI.

title.zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet：代码与性价比跃升

summary.zh: 在 200K 上下文中强化代码、视觉理解和工具调用；演示价格为输入 $3、输出 $15 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Improved coding, vision and tool use in a 200K context window; demo pricing of $3/$15 per 1M tokens.

title.zh: Claude 4 Sonnet：面向 Agent 的持续执行

summary.zh: 增强多步骤 Agent、代码仓库理解与并行工具调用；200K 上下文，演示价格维持输入 $3、输出 $15。
summary.en: Added stronger multi-step agents, repository understanding and parallel tools; 200K context at demo pricing of $3/$15.

summary.zh: 上下文扩至 2M（预览），强化 Agent 与代码能力并降低误拒；演示价格为输入 $3、输出 $15 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Expanded to a 2M context preview with better agents, coding and fewer false refusals; demo pricing of $3/$15.

summary.zh: 上下文扩展到 2M tokens，新增长视频、代码库和大规模文档分析；演示价格为输入 $1.25、输出 $5 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Expanded to 2M tokens for long video, codebases and large documents; demo pricing of $1.25/$5 per 1M tokens.

summary.zh: 在长上下文上增加思考模式、代码执行与搜索增强；演示输出价格调整为 $10 / 百万 tokens。
summary.en: Added thinking, code execution and search grounding; demo output pricing changed to $10 per 1M tokens.

summary.zh: 以 MoE 架构降低训练与推理成本，强化中文和代码，并提供 API 与开放权重部署路径。
summary.en: Used MoE to reduce training and inference cost, strengthening Chinese and code with API and open-weight deployment.

summary.zh: 演示版本将上下文扩至 256K，并增加代码沙箱和 Agent 编排；价格随 API 或自托管环境变化。
summary.en: Demo release expands to 256K with code sandboxing and agent orchestration; cost depends on API or self-hosting.

summary.zh: 强化中文、代码和结构化输出，主要通过百炼 API 提供；价格随地区和云平台计费。
summary.en: Improved Chinese, code and structured output through Bailian APIs; pricing varies by region and cloud.

summary.zh: 演示版本统一快速与深度推理，新增 256K 上下文、并行工具调用和中文多模态理解。
summary.en: Demo release unifies fast and deep reasoning with 256K context, parallel tools and Chinese multimodality.
